method: log(actual/forecast) per day regressed on 0..1 drivers (ridge); contributions in stays; LightGBM SHAP sign check; 200x week-block bootstrap; grade A = interval excludes 0 and SHAP agrees, B = one of the two, C = neither. Theil: bias / variance / covariance shares of the squared error. Tracking signal |TS| > 4 = systematic bias in that month.
